title: Great app... But no updates
body:
This is a wonderful app, but there are some very little annoying things about it.

1. The overview button is too far to reach. It's not quick. I prefer the overview as my home screen so I can see all my habits at once and then tap on the one I want to. It'd be great if you add the option to choose whichever home screen user wants as per their needs. If there's a gesture for pinch-to-zoom overview it'd be awesome.

2. When swiping between cards, can you make it be able to swipe even when the user is in the dashboard, instead of coming all the way to the top again to swipe.

3. Need widgets please!!

4. Please add more cards. These didn't change since many years.

Thank you.

title: Great potential, wasted without updates
body:
Loved the feature of adding cards to track milestones or fetch data from Apple Health to corroborate with check-ins. The checkin is fast and easy. Photos are gorgeous and gives the app a very clean and simple look.

Couple of features that would make it a better app (worthy of 5 stars)
- Auto checkin (IFTTT style) based on data from Apple Health would be so much cooler.
- On the milestone card, date of check/done should be tracked.

It’s a shame the app is not being maintained. It is better than any other habit tracking app, despite no updates for almost a year. Would pay an annual subscription fee for this app if the developer(s) we’re updating it with new feature (like dark mode).
